verified: Entry ask and exit bid crossing are included in fill-based gross P&L and are reported separately from decision-price signal P&L.
Net P&L equals decision-price signal P&L plus execution P&L minus the round-trip statutory charge total.
The charge schedule is calculated with impact disabled when observed spread is already represented in the fills, preventing spread/impact double counting.
